ActionBridges.PoseRoute: ordinary poses recover through canonical 0 before the next entry; knees via 11; lying via 11 and 6
ActionBridges.Playback: complete authored intermediate poses from ground/seat/upper sheets; continuous opaque articulation only between adjacent registered keys; exact existing action endpoints
ActionBridges.ActionClock: frozen during entry and recovery; the original hold clock and 58% creation event begin after entry
ActionBridges.Requests: latest transient request wins; repeating current action does not restart; hard context/drag cancellation clears stale work

MotionExits.FirstKey: previous actual displayed actor; cold rendering reconstructs the frozen source clip key
MotionExits.MiddleKeys: complete authored poses with connected-raster anatomy registration; no internal crossfade
MotionExits.FinalKey: canonical basic standing pose 0 with the same root, facing and breathing as ordinary standing
MotionExits.Scheduling: one Behavior clock; latest transient request wins; repeated active action is a no-op; drag and context cancellation take priority

Outdoor.ClimbEntryExitPlayback: opaque connected-raster bridge between the exact standing drawing and the current climb body; no pose crossfade
Outdoor.GaitPlayback: continuous two-leg hip/knee/ankle skinning with planted support and swinging other leg, shared Journey clock
Outdoor.TemporalPolicy: single Behavior clock; continuous route phase; ordinary stop/action/tablet requests recover along the route before latest request dispatch
Outdoor.SoftReturn: finish the current ascent route, turn and visibly descend; an active descent continues; drag/context/support invalidation remains a hard cancellation

Nurture.ClipOrigin: start of lowering; variable footsteps and tablet stow are outside clip

Swing.Playback: continuous articulation of one opaque registered swing pose

MotionRegistration: walk retains row ground; trot/hop/turn use complete connected-raster anatomy registration; legacy Hop/TurnStandingHeights are not the playback scale
MovementTiming: distance-based steps, eased approach, .35-second settle before context; hop airborne-only travel, turn in place
BasicPoseRegistration: upright 0-5/9/10 use own standing height; bent 6/7/8/11 retain pose-0 height; measured alpha support overrides legacy FeetAnchor
DragPlayback: frozen actual grab pose; immediate pointer displacement
GracefulExit: all ordinary postures physically recover through standing; authored trot/hop/turn/Nurture/swing/tablet exits; mountain visible return; one latest transient request
SequenceInterpolation: complete authored opaque poses; connected-raster interpolation between adjacent real keys; continuous root and lift; exact canonical standing endpoints
